headline: Zee Media raises 14 key questions on Reliance Jio's debt and governance ahead of IPO
hook: Questions raised before a massive public offering
summary: Zee Media has raised 14 key questions concerning the debt and corporate governance of Reliance Jio ahead of its anticipated mega initial public offering. The queries touch upon financial liabilities and operational transparency of the telecom major. Indian retail investors tracking the upcoming listing should note these emerging governance concerns. The scrutiny could influence regulatory reviews and investor sentiment as the IPO process moves forward.
why_it_matters: Governance scrutiny could impact IPO valuation and investor appetite.
